# The Give — band tracker (published page)

The band-facing tracker, served at
https://gibsonds.github.io/thegive-tracker/

**This repo holds output, not source.** `index.html` is generated by `bin/artifact.py
--pages` in the private `thegive` tracker repo and copied here. Editing it by hand gets
overwritten on the next publish — change the YAML in the tracker repo instead.

It is public because GitHub Pages needs it to be, and because a page pinned to a stale
version was worse: artifact sharing could not follow "latest" for viewers outside the
org, so the band kept reading a frozen page. This URL is always current.

The page carries `noindex, nofollow` and contains no credentials, no drummer
candidates' names, and none of the private notes — that scrubbing is done by the
`--public` build and is the reason this is safe to serve openly.
